testCases.title: Test 1: Bridge Formation Legality (Opponent No Checkers)
testCases.objective: Verify that a move forming a 6-checker bridge is legal if the opponent (Black) has no checkers on the board.
testCases.boardSetup: White: Checkers in home board `{2@1, 1@2, 1@3, 0@4, 2@5, 1@6}` (indices 0-5). Black: No checkers on board.
testCases.expectations: Move pt5(idx4) -> pt4(idx3) with die 1 should not be flagged as forming an illegal bridge (`WouldFormBlockingBridge` returns false).
testCases.rulesInvolved: Bridge formation rule (illegal 6-in-a-row), exception when opponent has no checkers, `WouldFormBlockingBridge`.

testCases.title: Test 2: Bridge Formation Legality (Opponent Relief)
testCases.objective: Verify that forming a 6-checker bridge is legal if the opponent has at least one checker positioned ahead of the bridge.
testCases.boardSetup: White: Same home board setup as Test 1. Black: 14 checkers at point 7 (index 6), 1 checker at point 19 (index 18).
testCases.expectations: Move pt5(idx4) -> pt4(idx3) with die 1 should not be flagged as illegal (`WouldFormBlockingBridge` returns false) due to Black's checker at index 18 being "ahead".
testCases.rulesInvolved: Bridge formation rule, exception for opponent relief, `WouldFormBlockingBridge`.

testCases.title: Test 3: Illegal Bridge Direct Move Validation
testCases.objective: Verify that a direct move forming an illegal 6-checker bridge (opponent trapped behind) is invalid.
testCases.boardSetup: White: Same home board setup as Test 1. Black: All 15 checkers at head (point 12 / index 11).
testCases.expectations: Direct move pt5(idx4) -> pt4(idx3) with die 1 should be invalid (`IsValidCheckerMove` returns false).
testCases.rulesInvolved: Bridge formation rule (illegal 6-in-a-row), condition (opponent trapped behind), `IsValidCheckerMove`.

testCases.title: Test 4: Black forming an illegal bridge (White Behind)
testCases.objective: Verify Black cannot form a bridge if all White checkers are behind it.
testCases.rulesInvolved: Bridge formation (illegal if all opponents behind).

testCases.title: Test 5: Black Forming Legal Bridge (White Ahead)
testCases.objective: Verify Black forming a 6-checker bridge is legal if White has relief.
testCases.boardSetup: Black: Same as Test 4 but with 8@pt21(idx20). White: 1 checker at pt19(idx18) (behind), 14 checkers at pt1(idx0) (ahead).
testCases.expectations: Move pt21(idx20) -> pt16(idx15) with die 5 should not be flagged illegal (`WouldFormBlockingBridge` returns false) and should be valid (`IsValidCheckerMove` returns true).

testCases.title: Test 6: White Wrap-Around Bridge Illegality (Black at Head, Multiple Illegal 1-1 Moves)
testCases.objective: Verify White cannot form a wrap-around bridge with dice 1-1 in several illegal move scenarios.
testCases.boardSetup: White: `{10@pt24, 1@pt1, 1@pt2, 1@pt3, 1@pt4}` + 1@pt6(idx5). Black: 15@pt12(head, index 11). Dice: 1-1. Illegal: 23->22 as first move, 5->4 as first move, 4->3 after 3->2, 23->22, 5->4, and 23->22 after 3->2, 5->4, 4->3.
testCases.expectations: All the following are illegal: (1) 23->22 as first half-move, (2) 5->4 as first half-move, (3) 4->3 after 3->2, 23->22, 5->4, (4) 23->22 after 3->2, 5->4, 4->3.
testCases.rulesInvolved: Bridge formation (wrap-around), virtual coordinates, ahead rule, multiple illegal 1-1 scenarios, `WouldFormBlockingBridge`, `IsValidCheckerMove`.

testCases.title: Test 8: White forms legal bridge with opponent relief (via 9→8 and 10→7 moves)
testCases.objective: Verify that with dice {1, 3}, White can first move from 9 to 8 (legal due to opponent relief), then from 10 to 7, forming a legal bridge.
testCases.boardSetup: White: `{2@pt10(idx9), 2@pt11(idx10), 1@pt12(idx11), 10@pt13(idx12)}`. Black: `{10@pt1(idx0), 2@pt17(idx16), 2@pt18(idx17)}`. 15 checkers per player, none borne off.
testCases.expectations: White should successfully move 9→8 with die 1 and 10→7 with die 3, forming a legal bridge.
testCases.rulesInvolved: Bridge formation legality, opponent relief, two-step move sequence.
